Name: Ebenezer Stone
Description: The stone Samuel set up between Mizpah and Shen after Israel's victory over the Philistines, naming it Ebenezer, 'hitherto hath the LORD helped us,' in 1 Samuel 7:12.
BiblicalSignificance: It is a memorial of God's help, not a town: the stone that gave its name to remembrance after the earlier defeat at Ebenezer.
